segments.content:
Reigniting the Prime of Youth Chapter 29 Ying Chanxi Called Me to Go Grocery Shopping

The outdoor basketball court of the Attached High School No. 1.

After a gratifying 3v3 game.

Kong Junxiang sat down on a nearby long bench, took a sip of water, wiped the sweat from his forehead, and asked the two students beside him, "Which classes are you two in? You're pretty good at basketball."

"This kid is from Class Three of this year's advanced placement class," Teacher Zhao next to him pointed at Zhao Rongjun and said with a chuckle. "I don't know about the other one."

"Oh, so he's in your class?" Kong Junxiang raised his eyebrows, taking another look at Zhao Rongjun before turning to Li Luo.

Li Luo chuckled twice and replied, "I don't know which class I'm in yet."

"A new student, huh," Kong Junxiang smiled mischievously. "Then you'd better be careful. I'm the head teacher of Class Eight for the first years. You just blocked my shots twice. Pray you don't end up in my hands."

"Huh?" Li Luo was taken aback for a moment, then asked, "Are all the teachers at the Attached High School No. 1 this petty?"

"Only he's petty." On the other side, the chubby Teacher Sun adjusted his glasses. "Don't lump us in with him."

"They won't get the chance to teach you," Kong Junxiang said with a laugh. "Teacher Zhao is from Class Three, Teacher Sun is from Class One, and Teacher Cao is from Class One of the second years."

"I see." Li Luo's gaze shifted to the chubby, bespectacled Teacher Sun. He quickly walked over to shake his hand. "Teacher Sun, I gave you so many assists just now. You have to take good care of my friend in the future."

"Isn't your friend in Class Three?" Teacher Sun was stunned for a moment. He glanced at the quiet and socially anxious Zhao Rongjun and couldn't help but ask, "Shouldn't you be talking to Teacher Zhao?"

"Oh, I'm not talking about him." Li Luo blinked. "Another friend, she's in Class One."

"Oh? Who is it?" Teacher Sun became interested. "Anyone who can get into Class One is a top student among top students."

"Her name is Ying Chanxi." Li Luo smiled. "Teacher, you must know her. She's definitely the student who left the deepest impression on you."

"Ying Chanxi?" Teacher Zhao couldn't help but call out first. "Is that the girl who got first place in the test? The one who beat the second place by more than ten points."

"Ying Chanxi?" Teacher Sun's expression was also a bit surprised. He took another look at Li Luo, and his gaze grew meaningful. "Are you two very close? Although our school doesn't have an explicit rule against puppy love, you should still be a little careful."

"We're neighbors," Li Luo said. "Besides, I never said anything about puppy love. You're being a little sensitive, Teacher Sun."

"Hmph." Teacher Sun pursed his lips. "Go on and be stubborn."

"A student like Ying Chanxi is definitely going to be the main force, the leader, in competing for all sorts of national awards in the future." Kong Junxiang laughed. "Teacher Sun treasures her. I'd advise you not to cross his line."

"So that's how it is." Li Luo nodded in understanding.

But just then, Li Luo's phone rang.

He took his phone out of his pocket, apologized to the teachers, and then answered the call.

"Hello? What's up?"

"Are you coming back to cook dinner?" Ying Chanxi asked from the other end. "Should I go buy some groceries first?"

"Oh, let's go together then. We just finished playing." As Li Luo said this, he turned to the teachers, "Teachers, Ying Chanxi is asking me to go grocery shopping. We'll be leaving now."

Teacher Sun: "?"

Teacher Zhao: "?"

Kong Junxiang was also a bit surprised. "What's the situation?"

"Who are you talking to?" Ying Chanxi on the other end of the line also asked curiously. "Teacher? What teacher?"

"Your head teacher." Li Luo looked at Teacher Sun and gave a bright smile. "He's reminding you not to get into a relationship and to study hard, you know?"

Hearing this, Teacher Sun's face immediately darkened.

Ying Chanxi on the other end was also speechless. "Can't you at least be realistic when you lie? Didn't you say you were playing basketball? Teacher Sun is so fat, how could he possibly play basketball?"

By this point, Li Luo had already held the phone out toward Teacher Sun, thinking of letting the teacher and student have a chat.

He never expected Ying Chanxi to suddenly come out with a line like that, making both him and Teacher Sun feel awkward.

"Ahem, Ying Chanxi," Teacher Sun coughed twice to hide his awkwardness and began to speak. "Although I am a bit fat, I still know how to play basketball."

"Ah!" Ying Chanxi was startled and immediately began to apologize profusely. "I'm so sorry, so sorry, Teacher Sun. You're not actually that fat."

"It's alright." Teacher Sun's expression was amiable, with no hint of anger. "If you two have things to do, go ahead and get busy."

"Okay, okay, goodbye Teacher Sun."

Li Luo took his phone back and said to Ying Chanxi, "We're heading back then."

"I'll deal with you when you get back," Ying Chanxi said in a low, teeth-gritting voice.

"I have it on speakerphone."

"What?!"

"Don't worry, I was tricking you this time."

Li Luo chuckled and hung up the phone. He then called over to Zhao Rongjun and waved goodbye to the teachers.

After watching the two students leave, Kong Junxiang looked at Teacher Sun with a grin and teased:

"Don't tell me Li Luo and Ying Chanxi were already together in middle school? You've got to be careful with this. The trauma of a breakup on a student is far more impactful than just being in a relationship."

"Tsk." Teacher Sun looked at Li Luo's retreating figure in the distance. "The way this kid talks doesn't seem like a fifteen or sixteen-year-old student. The four of us teachers are standing right here, and he's still so slick."

"This kind of personality is good," Teacher Zhao said from the side. "Even if a student like this doesn't have high grades, he'll do well in society later on. Unlike that Zhao Rongjun from our class, you can tell he's an honest Joe at a glance. He'll easily be taken advantage of in the future."

"Alright, alright." Teacher Cao from the second-year Class One, who had been watching the show until now, patted his thigh and stood up from the bench. "Let's stop worrying for nothing here. Time to go eat."

...

At the entrance of the Bihai Lanting residential community.

Xu Youyu had come downstairs with Ying Chanxi to wait here for Li Luo to go grocery shopping with them.

She was still a bit speechless, because ever since she added that "Chong Ran" on QQ at noon, the person had not accepted her friend request.

Didn't he say he was her peer?

Then he should be on summer vacation, right?

How could he go an entire afternoon without logging into QQ to take a look?

As for Ying Chanxi beside her, Xu Youyu knew her.

Xu Youyu herself had graduated from Yucai Middle School, just one year ahead of Ying Chanxi and Li Luo.

She had met Ying Chanxi at some language and composition competitions back in middle school, and the two had even chatted.

But later, due to scheduling conflicts with various subject competitions, Ying Chanxi had followed her teacher's advice, given up on composition, and switched to other subjects.

She never thought they'd meet again while renting an apartment, and even become housemates.

"This Li Luo you're talking about, he's not your boyfriend, is he?" Xu Youyu chatted idly with Ying Chanxi. Seeing that she couldn't go three sentences without mentioning Li Luo, she couldn't help but ask curiously.

Hearing this, Ying Chanxi immediately shook her head fiercely. "I don't even like him, how could he be my boyfriend?"

The words had just left her mouth.

Li Luo and Zhao Rongjun had already walked around the corner and come face-to-face with them.

For some unknown reason, when Li Luo stopped in front of the two girls, his expression suddenly froze, and he remained stunned for a long time.

And when Ying Chanxi realized Li Luo had arrived, she subconsciously panicked for a second. Seeing his dazed expression, she thought he had overheard what she had just said.
